text:
ryan: ALERT — Canary for acme (canary-id 7f3) started routing to eu-aux and generating variant-compat errors, spikes in 5xx and tail latency on dedicated lanes. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/route/2145
sre-bot: [incident] 2145: route_error_rate spike > 5% across acme-prod canary
marta: omg, timeline? did we flip geo_precedence in the rollout rule? @devon
devon: I pushed the canary routing rule at 13:07 UTC. I changed precedence to allow aux as backup for capacity reasons — thought it would only hit on quota failover. my bad.
ryan: logs show fallback hops: origin->us-west->eu-aux, but eu-aux only has variant v1.3-quant which is incompatible with the pinned v1.4 in tenant config -> mismatch 422s
devon: snippet of the rule I applied:
```
route {
  tenant: acme
  precedence: [region, tier, canary]
  fallback: [aux-region]
}
```
marta: precedence should have been [canary, tier, region]. so canary was evaluated last, caused geo fallback to outrank canary target
ops-jan: mitigation in progress: 1) rollback routing rule (devon) 2) pin acme to primary region (ryan) 3) enable circuit-breaker to prevent cross-region fallthrough (aline)
devon: rolled back at 13:12 UTC -> traffic back to primary region, error rate falling but still seeing cached KV misses
aline: enabling circuit-breaker now (threshold 3 failures / 30s) and raising fallback-compat-check to strict
ryan: added temporary routing override in console: set acme.canary.force_target = us-west; pushing to infra
sre-bot: [deploy] routing-override applied by ryan at 13:14 UTC
marta: we need better telemetry: show "fallback hop count" and last-compatibility-check result in per-tenant traces. also UI: surface route-evaluation order in the rollout page so PMs can review before apply
devon: agree. propose adding a canary flag that short-circuits region fallback while canary_active=true
aline: +1. I'll own telemetry changes. I'll add trace fields: fallback_hops, chosen_variant, compat_check_pass
ops-jan: also add a soft-precheck in console that simulates evaluation order and reports mismatches before committing rules
ryan: immediate postmortem items (short): - why precedence changed in PR review? - add console precheck - telemetry fields + dashboard alert - default circuit-breaker for cross-region fallback
marta: creating postmortem doc and assigning owners. @devon please link PR that applied the change
devon: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/6745
marta: thanks. small follow-up: can we have a rollout UX tooltip that warns "this precedence may allow region fallback to override canary" ?
aline: will add tooltip copy and a confirm modal for precedence changes
ryan: nice work bringing it down quick. add to weekly ops review
marta: :thumbsup:
devon: sorry again, lesson learned — will add tests to the rule-eval unit suite
ops-jan: moving to incident channel for log retention/export. filing follow-up tickets: INF-829, INF-830, INF-831
sre-bot: incident closed (stabilized) at 13:30 UTC
marta: postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/incident/INF-828-draft
ryan: closing thread here, owners assigned. thx everyone.
